issue.title: Root command shell completion reads os.Args instead of the arguments passed to Run
issue.body:
## My urfave/cli version is

v3.14.0 (latest release). Also reproduced on main at 10f69fd3c38de86a3bc17810dcb7f818b494f027.

## Checklist

- [x] Are you running the latest v3 release? The list of releases is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/releases).
- [x] Did you check the manual for your release? The v3 manual is [here](https://cli.urfave.org/v3/getting-started/)
- [x] Did you perform a search about this problem? Here's the [GitHub guide](https://help.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/using-search-to-filter-issues-and-pull-requests) about searching.

## Dependency Management

- My project is using go modules.

## Describe the bug

When shell completion is requested at the root command, `DefaultCompleteWithFlags` reads the global `os.Args` instead of the arguments passed to `Command.Run`. Subcommands read `cmd.Args()`, so they are not affected:

https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/10f69fd3c38de86a3bc17810dcb7f818b494f027/help.go#L256-L263

A real shell completion works, because the shell starts the program and `main` passes `os.Args` to `Run`. The bug shows when `Run` gets other arguments: in tests, where `os.Args` holds the `go test` flags, and in a REPL or other embedded use, which `Run` already expects:

https://github.com/urfave/cli/blob/10f69fd3c38de86a3bc17810dcb7f818b494f027/command_run.go#L130-L135

## To reproduce

Save the program below as `main.go` in an empty directory, then run:

```sh
go mod init repro
go get github.com/urfave/cli/v3@v3.14.0
